intro: Senegal has about 18 million people and a reputation for hospitality, called teranga.

chapters.title: People
text: The Wolof are the largest group, and Wolof is spoken by most people; French is official. Pulaar, Serer and Diola are also spoken. About 95% of people are Muslim, many belonging to brotherhoods like the Mourides.

chapters.title: Touba
text: Each year millions travel to the holy city of Touba for the Grand Magal pilgrimage.
